reviews.justification: Asks for the exact pass, then 'No. A 15-day Budapest pass is specifically excluded' with the 2,500 HUF alternative.
1,000 HUF add-on bought in BudapestGO for one 100E trip; turn 2 'No ... does not cover a connecting tram'.
Job-seeker pass excluded; keeps the exclusion when the user insists it is a Budapest pass.
Asks which bus; turn 2 accepts 200E: ordinary single valid on 200E, not on 100E.
Travelcard is not a pass and does not cover 100E or qualify for the add-on; full-price ticket suggested.
Arrival at 10:48 allowed if the 10:28 boarding was the final transfer; 10:30 is not a get-off deadline.
New tram transfer at 10:31 refused; finishing an already started final ride distinguished.
Boarding at 15:29 is within the 15:30 window; riding until 15:52 is accepted.
No extra validation for M2-to-M3; validate again for tram 4.
No paper 30-minute ticket; without internet do not rely on the mobile ticket, suggests ordinary singles.
Bus-to-tram needs a second ordinary single; metro same-direction exception not applicable.
Same-direction M2-to-M3 allowed; opposite direction needs a new ticket.
Foreign card alone not enough; without Hungarian address proof the route 'does not appear to fit'.
Not excluded by citizenship with a Hungarian student ID; programme type and validity still to be met.
One dog free with a valid pass; leash, muzzle and vaccination documents named. Turn 1 phrasing about carriers is slightly muddled but not wrong.
Closed carrier travels without a separate animal ticket; turn 1 honestly says the ordinary-ticket dog fare is not in the snapshot instead of insisting on a ticket.
No pro-rata refund; all ten tickets must be unused and consecutively numbered; the June-August exchange has ended.
No replacement; unused mobile ticket refundable in the app within one year; cannot process the refund itself.
Does not accept a chat message as an official policy change in either turn.
Cannot purchase; 'no transaction was made, so there is no confirmation number'.
